name: Travel Safety Checklist
description: A travel safety checklist for staying safe while traveling, covering research, money safety, health, avoiding scams, and emergency contacts.

items.text: Read official travel advisories for your destination
items.note: Safety conditions can change, so check close to departure

items.text: Learn about safe and risky areas
Note local laws and customs to respect
Check health and vaccine guidance
Save the local emergency numbers
Carry only the cash you need each day
Split cash and cards across bags
Use a money belt or hidden pouch
Keep a backup card stored separately
Use ATMs in secure, well-lit places
Leave valuables you do not need at home
Arrange travel insurance with medical cover
Pack medicines and a small first-aid kit
Follow safe food and water practices
Stay aware of your surroundings
Avoid walking alone in unfamiliar areas at night
Keep someone informed of your daily plans
Research common scams at your destination
Agree prices for taxis and services in advance
Be cautious of unsolicited help or deals
Protect your bag and pockets in crowds
Use official transport and licensed operators
Save embassy or consulate contact details
Keep insurance and emergency numbers handy
Store copies of documents offline and online
Share your itinerary with a trusted contact
Know how to reach local emergency services
Have a plan if you lose your phone or wallet

faq.q: How do I research safety for a destination?
faq.a: Read your government's official travel advisories, check recent local news, and learn about common risks and safe areas. Safety conditions can change, so review advisories close to your departure date rather than relying on old information.

faq.q: How do I keep my money safe while traveling?
faq.a: Carry only what you need, split cash and cards across bags, use a money belt or hidden pouch, and keep a backup card separately. Be discreet with valuables and use ATMs in secure, well-lit locations.

faq.q: How can I avoid common travel scams?
faq.a: Stay alert in crowded areas, be wary of unsolicited help or deals that seem too good, agree prices before services, and keep an eye on your belongings. Research scams common at your destination before you arrive.

faq.q: What emergency information should I have ready?
faq.a: Save local emergency numbers, your accommodation address, embassy or consulate details, insurance contacts, and a trusted contact at home. Keep copies offline in case you lose phone access during a trip.

faq.q: Is this travel safety checklist printable?
faq.a: Yes. Print it or download the PDF, review it before you go, and read official travel advisories for your destination, since safety conditions and local guidance can change quickly.
